requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The printer must support new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and CMY bottle size greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To enable spill-free, reliable ink replacement and support high yield for customers, reducing maintenance frequency and enhancing user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design, compatible bottle interface on printer, and supply chain updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer, when a user inserts a new NGB keyed bottle, it should fit only in the correct slot, operate spill-free, and deliver at least the specified page yields.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The ink bottle system must provide spill-free reliability during user replacement and operation.
requirements.Rationale: To avoid mess, improve safety, and enhance customer satisfaction during ink refilling.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on bottle and tank interface design, IDS startup algorithm.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: When a user replaces or refills ink, no ink should leak or spill under normal usage conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (New Output Assembly - Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and ensures secure, tamper-evident assembly for ink handling.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updated NOA-F design and manufacturing process changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F component must include specified features and pass reliability and assembly tests without requiring changes to push-push and TDF.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA
requirements.Description: The printer must reuse the SuperAmp Si Printhead Assembly (PHA) from previous models.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology and reduce R&D and manufacturing costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new ink system and electronics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA is integrated and passes functional and reliability tests in the new printer.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi/Nessie Inks Without Reformulation
requirements.Description: The printer must use existing Magi and Nessie pigment inks without any reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To streamline supply chain and ensure ink compatibility with existing products.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system compatibility, IDS modeling for startup and EOL.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably with current Magi/Nessie inks and meets print quality and yield targets.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Modeling for IDS and Air Management
requirements.Description: Reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), Air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F EOL, must be performed.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure long-term reliability and optimal performance of ink delivery and air management systems.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and air management system design, simulation tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models and reliability tests completed and validated for startup and EOL scenarios.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on Print Quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure long-term print quality and ink reliability in the new tank system.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires tank design and ink chemistry data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model is completed and reviewed, with documented impact on PQ.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Part in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To facilitate efficient repairs and maintain product uptime during warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Service supply chain, NOA-F component inventory.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F can be ordered and replaced as a warranty part with documented procedures.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumably a sensor or label technology) onto the printer lid.
requirements.Rationale: Likely for enhanced tracking, authentication, or serviceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Lid design and Acumen 6 technology integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present, functional, and passes all QA tests on the lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and New Ink Systems
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and create molds for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To enable production of new components and ensure manufacturing readiness.
requirements.Dependencies: Production line redesign and tooling procurement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines are updated, validated, and capable of producing new components at required volumes.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer so that customers can replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F themselves.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design for user replacement, documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a customer, when following instructions, they can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F without tools beyond those supplied.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To offer a competitive warranty and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, consumables design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably for at least 80,000 pages under normal usage conditions within warranty period.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service) Model
requirements.Description: Enable the printer to be used within a PaaS (Printing as a Service) business model.
requirements.Rationale: To support evolving business models and increase recurring revenue opportunities.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with PaaS platform, billing, and serviceability features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be enrolled, monitored, and managed via HP’s PaaS infrastructure.

requirements.Title: Product Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Product must have Reddington ID with an increased tank size and no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity and maintain compatibility with existing document feeder.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank redesign, chassis integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes ID review, tank increase is implemented, and ADF compatibility is validated.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Product must meet EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To meet regulatory and market environmental standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for compliance, documentation, and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for relevant SKUs.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with new tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and space efficiency with the larger tank.
requirements.Dependencies: Tray and tank design, mechanical integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit and function correctly with new tank design and pass all functional tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To provide an enhanced user interface and improve usability.
requirements.Dependencies: Display sourcing, UI design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is integrated and passes usability and QA tests.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage a four-tube platform using Sayan Sibstar tubes, with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: To support the new ink delivery system and tank configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, routing, and integration with IDS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube system is implemented and validated for flow rate, reliability, and integration.

requirements.Title: Aerosol Management in Service Station
requirements.Description: Update service station for aerosol management, with changes to spit platform due to tank.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain internal cleanliness and print quality as tank design changes.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and spit platform redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system functions as intended and passes internal contamination tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamics and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamics and force model to account for new tube routing and weight changes.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure printhead movement remains precise and reliable with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Carriage and tube design, simulation tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage force model validated and printer passes printhead movement accuracy tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify the paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability over the extended warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path design and materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes durability tests for at least 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance component as a serviceable part to be replaced after 80,000 page life.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain printer performance and extend usable life beyond warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design, service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be serviced/replaced after 80k pages, with instructions provided.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection for the Ink Delivery System, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Integration).
requirements.Rationale: To support the new ink system and ensure reliable connections.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and tank design, connector sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All connections are reliable, pass leak and flow tests, and are keyed for correct assembly.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management process for the Ink Delivery System.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable printer startup and minimize air-related print defects.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm is implemented, tested, and meets startup reliability criteria.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality goals and depletion metrics to meet the defined page yield.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure customer satisfaction and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ testing, IDS and ink system performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion meet or exceed defined targets in all test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs and leverage proven electronics.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new printer architecture.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components are integrated and pass functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To provide wireless connectivity and support modern network standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Wi-Fi module sourcing and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module is integrated, passes connectivity, and security tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize Dune as the firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To standardize firmware development and leverage existing platform features.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware compatibility with hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably with Dune firmware and passes all functional tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust security for device, data, and network interactions.
requirements.Dependencies: Security feature integration in hardware and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All Gauss4.xx security features are implemented and pass security validation tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via multiple HP/SMB/ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: To address a broad customer base and support diverse use cases.
requirements.Dependencies: Software and services integration, onboarding documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be configured and managed for all business models and onboarding paths.

requirements.Title: Scan, SMB Manageability, and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: To provide comprehensive functionality for business and enterprise users.
requirements.Dependencies: Software integration, driver development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solutions are integrated, functional, and pass user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure compatibility with existing and future HP software ecosystems.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver and client software integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass installation and functionality tests.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) modes.
requirements.Rationale: To meet competitive performance benchmarks and customer expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine design, firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in all relevant test scenarios.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must have a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure long-term reliability and reduce maintenance frequency.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA component quality and durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life tests for at least 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Warranty must cover 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To offer a competitive warranty and align with industry standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Component reliability and service processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and service processes support 2 years or 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Printer must include a serviceable maintenance box for easy user or technician replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce downtime and simplify maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily accessible and replaceable, passing serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Support (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Support for 12,000 page yield for CMYK and 6,000 trade pages is desirable, but flexible based on business needs.
requirements.Rationale: To offer higher yield options for certain markets or customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system and consumables design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be configured for these yields if required by business strategy.
